name: io.github.SavasTanriverdi/moho-studio-mcp
title: Moho Studio MCP
description: MCP server and Lua 5.4 plugin for live 2D animation, rigging, lip-sync, glTF, and CLI rendering in Moho 14.4

environmentVariables.name: MOHO_STUDIO_IPC_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional override for the local IPC directory shared with the Moho Lua plugin (defaults to %TEMP%\moho-studio-mcp).

environmentVariables.name: MOHO_STUDIO_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Optional tool profile exposed by tools/list: full (default, 82 tools), core (28 tools), rigging, animation, or vector.
